notes.title: The Mobile Version is Now Live!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the game's mobile version has been released! Go on a lifelong journey alongside Sir Brante no matter where you are: in queue, on a commute, or at home, lying down on the couch.

With stunning graphics and a gripping storyline, our narrative-driven RPG will transport you to a world where every choice has its price and leads to irreversible consequences. Choose your path wisely... After all, the fate of not only Sir Brante himself, but everyone around him lies in your hands!

The mobile version is available on iOS and Android devices.

Download now!

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante update 30.04.21
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! We have prepared a small patch that will be implemented today and is going to help those of you who have chosen the Nobleman path. It includes numerous small fixes that may not be worth mentioning by themselves, but we would still like to give you a rundown of the two major aspects of this update:

1) Several users have reported a critical bug at the end of Chapter IV ‘Peace,’ where the game would freeze with no way to continue playing even if one was to restart the entire chapter. We have tracked down the error that caused this and, starting today, it should no longer be a problem.

2) In Chapter IV ‘Peace’ there were two extra events (‘The time has come’ and ‘Final preparations’) that should not have been available for players with level 10 Career or Justice skills as this goes against the logic of the plot. We have fixed this sequence of events, and it should no longer pop up in this chapter.

Finally, a small reminder for those who still haven’t played The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante or would like to surprise their loved ones with a pleasant gift - today is the last day you can purchase the game with a 15% discount. Don’t hesitate to grab your copy now!

notes.title: The very first game patch & patchnotes
The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante release dev stream
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Some days ago we announced the QA session with The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante dev team and we must admit it took us some time to make it happen. But hey, we made it! 
Although we couldn't go live due to the significant time difference, we managed to record a 2-hour video and will broadcast it starting from Match 4th, 10 AM PT on The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante Steam page.

Pop in and hear some development stories, The Blessed Arknian Empire lore explanations, and more. The stream will be spoiler-free, so don't hesitate to watch it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/5c17dd3f04f19c2b57afb1dec63d036ca4893069.gif

If you just landed on our page, The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is a narrative-driven text-based RPG set in a ruthless medieval realm that comes to life on the pages of the protagonist's journal. The game launches March 4th on Steam, EGS, GoG, and 101XP store.

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante progress update
notes.notes:
Hello, everybody! Sever Studio’s here with the upcoming narrative-driven RPG The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante. We haven’t shared any game updates in a while, but rest assured — the development process is moving along at full speed. In this article, we’d like to give you a progress update specifically in regards to what we’re working on at the moment and what awaits you in the future. 

Let’s dive in, shall we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/e265898a8c35a24e2cf956ae39752121904ed900.gif

Our team is currently busy testing the game logic and complex relations between various in-game events. The plotline of The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante isn’t linear — there are 3 distinct endings with an equal number of major interconnected routes the player can take.

Writing a story like that isn’t easy: just one possible path towards an ending consists of 206 (!) in-game scenes and plot twists. These include different outcomes of historical events, various states of internal affairs in the Empire (especially in the last chapter of the game), variations in the protagonist’s as well as his family members’ social status, secondary characters’ development, and so on and so forth.

Check out the mind map for just ONE game ending below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/c36c6e90aeff0d4cb4bcb8788fcb244e18144541.jpg

The most important task here is to identify and resolve any possible contradictions that might arise should two distinct story branches collide. And trust us — it takes a lot of hard work to polish up a tale of such epic proportions!

Other than that, we can proudly state that most of the game’s content has already been finalized: with all storyline events written down and the corresponding illustrations fully drawn, the game’s development is nearing completion. At the moment, we’re brushing up minor errors, fixing bugs, optimizing the game for common (and not so common) screen resolutions, while also testing and working on The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante English localization.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/dacddc12740a3a83739c80e0e0da72030d3cec28.gif

Let us stop here for now and elaborate a bit on the localization process. The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is twice the size of the “Hobbit” novel by J.R.R. Tolkien and boasts more than 200K words. 
As you can imagine, it’s an ENORMOUS amount of content in need of translation and editing. Therefore, we kindly ask everyone who’s waiting for the game to remain patient as we aim to release a fully functional and debugged product and won’t settle for anything less. 

Thank you once again for your immense support! Don’t forget to wishlist The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante on Steam and follow the latest news on Twitter  or Discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/
